51094965.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human MDM2 by by Surface Plasmon Resonace (SPR) spectroscopy binding assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Human MDM2 (residues 17–111) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20). Compounds were diluted in the running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 nM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The dissociation constant (K_D) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
